description: This file defines a template class 'PingPongEnabled' that provides WebSocket ping-pong functionality, including starting pings, handling pong responses, and managing connection states. It includes methods for scheduling pings, handling pong timeouts, and printing connection states, utilizing the websocketpp library.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class that adds WebSocket ping-pong heartbeat functionality to derived classes, managing connection health and state.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes the ping-pong process by setting pong handlers and scheduling the first ping.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules the next ping operation after a specified interval.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message over the WebSocket connection if the connection is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handles receipt of a pong message and schedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handles pong timeout events by closing the connection.

methods.name: printConnectionState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the WebSocket connection.
